page_controller.text:
Controller view

About this data

Every number here comes from the general ledger that ERA exports each night (report 381, every account by month). Department gross and expense lines are grouped the same way as on Expense coverage, so the two pages agree. A month counts as closed once ERA has recorded its profit; the open month keeps moving until accounting closes it.

Store is read from the account number: no letter is Ford, M is Mazda, I and H are the Truck Center. Truck shop expense is counted with Service, where its gross is. The ledger gives balances, not what is inside them. What is inside comes from four ERA schedule reports that run at 3:00 AM and 8:00 PM and is always as of the last run, for all stores, whatever month is picked above.

On a schedule, an item is open when the lines on its control number do not add up to zero. Its age comes from the newest charges that make up what is left. Parts, service and body shop receivables are aged by invoice, each invoice counted once. Only the largest and oldest items of each schedule are listed, with no phone numbers or addresses.

MBF Exceptions Review

Exceptions Review

Waiting for the morning run

Your work queue from the nightly checks, biggest dollars first. Flags on the same RO, deal or op code are one case: one owner, one due date and one dollar exposure, with each reason cleared on its own as Corrected (changed in ERA) or OK as is (checked, nothing wrong) with a note. Until you pick an owner it is the person on the flag, due 7 days after it showed up. Hand a case to a manager with a check-back day and it shows on Today when that day comes. Cases turn amber at 3 days open and red at 7; anything 7+ days or past due rolls into Mike's Read.

2027 rules, dates and contacts
  • Sales standard (0.45% of base MSRP less D&D, program 70460): Staffing & Training + DDT ≥ 60% + Connected Services trial activations ≥ 60% in the same report card month.
  • Trial activations are judged on the prior month's sales. January 2027 is auto-qualified; January sales decide the February report card. December habits are what January will show.
  • Ownership standard (0.45%, program 70462): Staffing & Training + BBT coding on MPIs ≥ 60% + VCP conversion ≥ 18% + Video MPI attestation (auto for Q1–Q2 if attested in 2026).
  • Staffing & Training (O300): 80% of people in each of 8 roles base certified (Levels 1 and 2), at least one person in each: Parts Manager, Sales Manager, Sales Consultant, Service Manager, Service Advisor, Financial Services Manager, Digital Marketer, CX Remote Experiences Coordinator.
  • Q1 and Q2 targets are set; Q3 and Q4 come out in Q2 2027 and are expected to rise.
  • Payment cadence: Sales standard earns on the report card month's sales; Ownership earns on the prior month's sales; paid on the VINCENT payment statement the next month.
  • Appeals: one per missed month, filed by the end of the following month; documents within 30 days; final appeal to the Dealer Policy Board within 15 days.
  • Questions: Sales or Ownership Zone Manager; FCP headquarters 866-534-5054, FCP@ansira.com, Mon–Fri 9:30–6:30 ET. FCP site goes live Jan 5, 2027.
